name: Keep Calm And Carry On
aka: Keep Calm And Carry On Red
look: A plain bright red poster with a small white royal crown centered near the top and nothing else, ready for the white capital-letter slogan of the Keep Calm and Carry On poster.
use: A parody of the calm wartime slogan. People write keep calm and then swap in their own advice, excuse or joke, in white capitals under the crown.
slots: first line, usually keep calm (under the crown)
the rest of the slogan: and ___ (below)
describe: red poster with a white crown at the top
blank keep calm sign with a crown
british poster template with a crown and space for text
red background with a crown for a calm slogan
plain red rectangle with a little white crown
origin: Based on a British government morale poster designed in 1939, which was rediscovered decades later and endlessly parodied.
